data.gender_notes: Ramnaresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the king of Rama or the ruler of the people. The name Ramnaresh carries the meaning “Rama's king” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramnaresh usually hope their child will grow to embody rama's king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power of Rama and the strength and courage of a warrior.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramnaresh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ramnaresh" carries a rich cultural heritage, rooted in Hinduism, as it references the revered deity Lord Rama. Lord Rama is one of the major figures in the Indian epic Ramayana, which is an influential text in Hinduism. It is believed that dwelling in this name could impart a deep sense of spirituality, morality, courage, and righteousness.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of this name lies in the embodiment of the qualities associated with Lord Rama, who is considered an embodiment of "Dharma," or cosmic morality. In the name "Ramnaresh," the essence of this revered deity is encapsulated, symbolizing the rule and guidance of Dharma within the individual's being. This name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of adhering to moral principles and virtues, while upholding self-control and inner peace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramnaresh: In the name Ramnaresh, Ram signifies the divine essence of God, while Naresh implies the ruler or the king within us, symbolizing self-rule and inner power guided by the divine.
